action: Tap the indicators entry point in the bottom chart toolbar
result: Indicator browser opens over the chart
notes: 3P says tap '+' at bottom then 'Indicators'. TV's Android article confirms a 'lower toolbar' with a Drawings icon and an Analysis hub beside it, but does not name the indicators button. Exact iOS icon/label UNVERIFIED.

action: Tap the Analysis hub entry in the lower toolbar (adjacent to Drawings icon)
result: Hub exposes chart-level actions (New/Save/Open at top, chart settings, Object tree, multi-layout options)
notes: iOS release notes name 'Analysis hub' explicitly: v2.122.1, v2.120.2, v2.139.0. TV Android help places it 'near Drawings icon in the lower toolbar'. THIS IS THE MOBILE STAND-IN FOR DESKTOP CHROME.

action: Tap the Technicals category
result: Browsable built-in indicator list
notes: Tab set (Technicals/Financials/Community) documented for Supercharts/desktop only. Presence and naming on the iOS picker ASSUMED FROM DESKTOP.

action: Tap Financials category
result: Financial metrics browsable
notes: Desktop-documented. Symbol-class dependent (equities). Mobile presence UNVERIFIED.

action: Tap Community scripts category
result: 100,000+ public indicators browsable
notes: TV states '100,000+ public indicators' platform-wide. 3P mobile guides say you can search any indicator by name in the mobile search bar. Mobile tab existence ASSUMED.

action: Tap My scripts category
result: User scripts applicable to chart
notes: NOT documented for mobile anywhere. Scripts are account-bound so they should surface, but the tab is unconfirmed. AUTHORING is web-only.

action: Browse/apply a strategy script
result: Strategy visuals on chart WITHOUT a Strategy Tester report panel
notes: KEY GAP. No first-party statement that Strategy Tester exists on iOS. 3P asserts it does not. APPLYING a strategy vs READING its performance report are different capabilities.

action: Tap search field and type an indicator name
result: Filtered indicator results across categories
notes: 3P mobile guide: 'search for any indicator by name or category in the search bar and tap on it to add it to the chart.'

action: Tap the star to the left of an indicator name
result: Indicator added to Favorites; appears in Favorites tab / dropdown
notes: TV article is platform-neutral in text but screenshot-driven from desktop. Mobile star affordance ASSUMED. Favourites are account-level and sync.

action: Open picker and view default landing list
result: Faster re-application
notes: NO evidence found for a Recents surface on mobile. Listed for lane completeness - treat as unconfirmed.

action: Tap the indicator name
result: Indicator plots on main pane or a new pane per its default
notes: 3P: 'To add an indicator to the chart, simply tap on it.' Whether the sheet AUTO-DISMISSES on apply is UNVERIFIED and is a meaningful interaction detail.

action: Wait for script compile/calculation
result: Legend entry appears; plot renders after calculation
notes: Loading/spinner treatment on iOS not documented. TV documents calculation-timeout errors platform-wide but not the mobile presentation.

action: Tap outside the sheet or swipe it down
result: Return to chart with indicators applied
notes: Assumed iOS sheet convention. Not documented.

action: Observe legend
result: THE PRIMARY MOBILE INDICATOR-MANAGEMENT SURFACE - one row per indicator under the symbol name
portrait: legend collapsed by default to save width
notes: iOS-SPECIFIC TV article locates the legend 'under the ticker name'. TV's mobile blog adds that the mobile legend shows only close price + % change by default.

action: Tap the arrow button under the symbol name
result: Legend expands to list all indicators with per-row eye / gear / trash controls
notes: Article lives in Help Center > Mobile apps > Application settings, so its text IS mobile-scoped: 'open the chart legend by clicking the arrow button under the symbol name'. Does not disambiguate iOS vs Android.

action: Tap the eye icon on the indicator's legend row
result: Indicator hidden but retained in the layout and still counted
notes: THE ONLY TRULY iOS-SPECIFIC INDICATOR ARTICLE TV PUBLISHES. Verbatim: 'To change the visibility of the indicator, you need to click on the eye icon in the legend under the ticker name.' Whether a hidden indicator still consumes plan quota is UNVERIFIED.

action: Tap the gear icon on the indicator's legend row
result: Indicator settings sheet opens with editable parameters
notes: Mobile-folder article: 'Click the gear icon to change the settings of an indicator.'

action: Tap the trash icon on the indicator's legend row
result: Indicator deleted immediately; its pane collapses if it was the only occupant
notes: Mobile-folder article: 'Click the trash icon to remove an indicator.' NO UNDO AFFORDANCE DOCUMENTED - a notable destructive-action gap on touch.

action: Tap the indicator's name in the legend
result: Parameters, colors and properties adjustable
notes: 3P claims tapping the NAME opens settings directly. TV's own mobile article routes settings through the GEAR icon. CONFLICT - likely both work, or the 3P source is describing the gear.

action: Tap Inputs
result: Length, source, offset etc. editable
notes: Inputs/Style/Visibility tab triad documented for the DESKTOP settings dialog. Mobile tab presence/order/naming ASSUMED FROM DESKTOP.

action: Tap the Source field and pick close/open/high/low/hl2 etc.
result: Indicator computed on the new series
notes: Source can also be ANOTHER indicator's plot (indicator-on-indicator). Whether the mobile source picker lists other applied indicators is UNVERIFIED and is a real capability question.

action: Tap Style
result: Per-plot color swatches, line width, plot type, opacity controls
notes: ASSUMED FROM DESKTOP.

action: Tap a plot's color swatch
result: Plot recolored live
notes: Mobile color-picker design (grid vs wheel, custom hex entry) entirely UNVERIFIED.

action: Tap Visibility
result: Per-interval toggles (ticks/seconds/minutes/hours/days/weeks/months)
notes: TV documents the Visibility tab for both drawings and scripts, desktop only.

action: Invoke Defaults > Reset settings
result: Indicator back to factory config
notes: 'Defaults' menu (Reset / Save as default / Apply defaults to all) is a desktop dialog FOOTER control. Mobile equivalent UNVERIFIED.

target: Move to > New pane above/below / Existing pane / Main pane
action: Open the indicator's three-dot menu and choose a Move to target
result: Indicator overlaid on price or isolated in its own pane; panes reflow
portrait: pane heights compress with each added pane
notes: TV documents TWO desktop routes: drag, or the three-dot 'Move to' menu. Drag is unrealistic on a phone legend; the menu route is the plausible mobile path but is NOT documented for mobile.

action: Tap the separator to SELECT it, then drag vertically
result: Custom pane height split
portrait: critical on phone - pane height is the scarcest resource
landscape: more vertical room per pane; unknown
notes: IMPORTANT NUANCE: TV DOES document a mobile touch resize - 'select the desired border with a single tap and then move it. A double tap on any border returns the charts to their default position.' But that article is about resizing CHARTS WITHIN A MULTI-CHART LAYOUT, not indicator PANES. Extended by analogy - unverified. The TAP-TO-SELECT-THEN-DRAG pattern is a notable TV touch-design choice.

action: Double tap the separator
result: Panes snap back to default proportions
notes: Same caveat as IND-0027: documented for multi-chart layout borders on mobile, extended to pane separators by analogy.

target: Pane buttons (move up/down, collapse, maximize, remove)
action: Tap a pane button on the pane's edge
result: Pane stack reorganized
portrait: buttons may be hidden on narrow screens
notes: Documented as a Canvas setting in Supercharts (desktop). Desktop pane buttons are HOVER-REVEALED - hover does not exist on touch, so the mobile reveal mechanism is a genuine open question.

action: Scroll the Analysis hub down and tap the Object tree icon
result: Object tree opens listing indicators, drawings and symbols - the central object-management surface on mobile
notes: STRONGEST evidence that the OBJECT TREE EXISTS ON MOBILE. Verbatim (Android): 'Open the Analysis Hub menu (near Drawings icon) in the lower toolbar', 'Scroll it down', 'Click on the Object Tree icon'. TV publishes NO iOS equivalent - iOS parity is INFERRED.

action: Select an indicator in the tree
result: Pop-up window with that object's visibility settings
notes: Verbatim (Android): 'Select the necessary indicator and change its visibility settings in the pop-up window.' iOS parity INFERRED.

target: Indicator row when at plan limit
action: Attempt to add one more indicator
result: Add blocked; upsell/limit message expected
notes: LIMITS (TV pricing page, account-level so they apply on iOS): indicators per chart - Basic 2, Essential 5, Plus 10, Premium 25, Ultimate 50. Charts per tab 1/2/4/8/16. Saved layouts 1/5/10/10/10. The LIMIT is official; the iOS ERROR/UPSELL PRESENTATION is UNVERIFIED.

action: Save the current indicator set under a name
result: Reusable indicator template stored on the account
notes: 3P mobile guide describes '+' > Templates > Save as Template. TV confirms indicator templates exist platform-wide and adds a sharp gotcha: 'Drawing objects are not saved in the indicator template, so they are removed from the additional indicator panels when using templates.'

action: Tap a template name
result: Current indicator set REPLACED wholesale by the template's set
notes: Destructive-replace semantics + the drawing-removal side effect make this a RISKY one-tap action on mobile. Confirmation dialog presence UNVERIFIED.

target: 'Use on chart' on a script publication
action: Tap 'Use on chart'
result: Community script applied to a chart
notes: TV documents this as a WEB flow ('opens a new tab'). Whether the iOS app intercepts the deep link, or the in-app Community tab replicates it, is UNVERIFIED. A candidate 'operation that requires leaving the chart'.

action: Follow the author's stated request procedure
result: Access granted only by the author, out-of-band
notes: TV: 'If the Use on chart button is unavailable... follow the author's instructions, which are located to the right or below the publication body.' The LAYOUT reference is a desktop description.

action: Attempt to open the Pine Editor in the iOS app
result: No documented in-app Pine Editor - must leave the app to author scripts
notes: TV's Pine Editor article describes it exclusively as a web right-toolbar panel with floating/docked/detached-window modes - all desktop-window concepts. TV never states 'not on mobile'. Multiple 2026 YouTube tutorials titled 'How to open Pine Editor in TradingView Mobile App' imply a WORKAROUND, not a native feature. TREAT AS LIKELY DESKTOP-ONLY BUT NOT PROVEN.

action: Attempt to open the Strategy Tester performance report
result: Backtest metrics likely unavailable on iOS
notes: 3P only: 'TradingView's mobile app has Bar Replay, but it doesn't have the full Strategy Tester.' Bar Replay IS confirmed on mobile by TV. No first-party statement either way on Strategy Tester. HIGH-VALUE UNRESOLVED.

action: Long tap and hold on a bar
result: Value-tracking mode: crosshair + legend expands to OHLC, Change AND indicator values for that bar
notes: THE CORE MOBILE INDICATOR-READING INTERACTION. Default mobile legend deliberately shows only close + % change to avoid overlap; OHLC and indicator values are gated behind long-press. Source dated 2019 - STALE but never superseded; the charting-library mobile doc still describes identical behavior.

action: Drag the pointer across bars
result: Scrub indicator values across history
notes: TV: 'You can move the bar pointer.'

target: 'Add this indicator to the entire layout'
action: Invoke the layout-wide apply option
result: Indicator replicated to all charts in the layout
notes: TV documents 'Add this indicator to the entire layout' as a desktop context-menu item. iOS multi-layout IS confirmed to exist (v2.120.2), so the precondition is met - but this specific menu item is UNVERIFIED on mobile.

action: Rotate device
result: Chart reflows; more horizontal bars visible; toolbar/legend density unknown
notes: No first-party documentation of iOS landscape indicator/legend behavior. Flagged because pane stacking + legend width are the two things landscape most changes.

action: Long-press the price scale
result: Chart settings open (incl. pane separator styling)
notes: v2.139.0. Relevant here because pane separator + scale settings live in Chart settings. NOTE: the charting-library mobile doc says only ONE price scale can be shown on mobile - a real constraint for multi-indicator overlays.
